blocker: The agent's custom Node.js ELF extraction script failed to extract any matching memory addresses when run against a test binary, yielding 0.00% coverage against the 75% required threshold.
narrative: The agent wrote a Node.js script (extract.js) intended to parse an ELF binary and extract its memory values into a JSON object mapping memory addresses to integers. During evaluation, the test suite executed the script against a newly compiled test binary and found that 0.00% of the expected memory values were present in the generated output JSON.
